_comment: The DSH compatibility anchor — the one version of the harness this repository's
suites and its `!!js`-free bundle patch are known to work against.
SPEC §0.1 forbids following `latest`: DSH is a Developer Preview and may break
compatibility. SPEC asks for a pinned Git commit; this deployment has no source
checkout, so the published version number is the anchor instead (approved in M0,
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS AS A MACHINE-READABLE PIN:
Before it, the same version string lived in three unrelated places — the baseline
document, the CI workflow, and whatever the developer happened to have installed.
Nothing compared them, which is the failure mode this repository keeps paying for
(architecture-decisions D38: one vocabulary added to one of three lists, and the
other two then reject a correct input for the wrong reason).
`deepblend/tests/contract/toolchain-pins.test.mjs` now asserts that all four agree:
deployment the workspace is actually linked against.
To upgrade DSH: change this file, the baseline doc and the CI workflow in ONE
commit, then run the full acceptance suite before pushing.
